title: $239bn by 2028: What the Supplement Boom Means for Coaches
titleDe: 239 Milliarden Dollar: Was der Supplement-Boom für dein Studio bedeutet
description: The global dietary supplement market is forecast to reach $239.4bn by 2028, growing from $112.3bn in 2018, while functional food and beverage adds another $529.66bn in parallel — operators who embed product recommendations into their programming sit inside the fastest-growing slice of consumer health spending. A living Sqwod Intelligence report.
study: dietary supplements and functional foods worldwide
takeaways: The global supplement market hit $158bn in 2023 and is on track for $239.4bn by 2028 [0].
North America alone was a $72.06bn supplement market by 2026 — the largest regional block by far [1].
Probiotic supplements reached $2.5bn in 2023 and are forecast to hit $3.28bn by 2027 [4].
46% of supplement consumers across the US, UK and China used Vitamin C — the single most popular product [16].
China exported 341.93 million kg of vitamins in 2022, dwarfing every other country and exposing supply-chain concentration risk [8].
The vitamins and minerals segment grew 8.01% in 2023, faster than any year since the 2021 pandemic spike [14].
